caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass candlestick holder centered on a plain, light beige background. The candlestick holder has a wide, hexagonal base with slanted sides and a slightly flared bottom edge, transitioning into a narrower, multi-faceted stem with a series of stacked rings or ridges at its midpoint. The top of the holder features a shallow, circular cup designed to hold a candle. The glass is rendered with various shades of gray and white to indicate transparency and reflective highlights. The entire composition is neatly outlined by a thin, single-line rectangular border set within the background. There are no other objects, patterns, or colors present in the drawing.
title: Candlestick
